Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02029] Reporting writing of data failed to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service WriteDataByIdentifier is received, which results in a nega-
tive response, the DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_WRITE_DATA_FAILED
to IdsM (see [26] and table [SWS_DM_02030]) with the context data given in
[SWS_DM_02030].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02030] Security event context data definition: SEV_UDS_WRITE_
DATA_FAILED
